(1) The MCP design provides a platform for real time embedded system development and education.

1) a real-time embedded system is best developed by a team of engineers with expertise in both hardware and software; and 2) a real-time operating system is a must-have for any real time embedded control system.

(a) a real-time embedded control system for wireless mobile platforms can be designed and developed using a multi-threaded software architecture, (b) a real-time Linux OS is a viable option for the operating system, (c) the real-time Linux kernel is a good choice for the operating system kernel, (d) a real-time operating system framework is a good choice, (e) an event-driven software architecture is a good choice.

the development of real time embedded control system software for wireless mobile robotic platforms.
the development of an embedded control system for a miniature car, with wireless communications, real time control, and multi-thread software architecture.
the design and development of an embedded control system for the wireless mobile robot MCP.
